column1: # ZAP API-scan rule thresholds (generated with -g, then reviewed, WP-13).
# Defaults are FAIL for active alerts; the entries below tune known-noisy rules for a
# JSON REST API behind an IAM-gated proxy (no browser, no cookies, no CSP surface locally).

column3: (X-Content-Type-Options) - set at the edge/proxy, not the API
(Anti-clickjacking header) - API returns JSON, not framed HTML
(Server leaks version via Server header) - uvicorn, acceptable locally
(Server leaks info via X-Powered-By) - not emitted
(CSP header not set) - JSON API, CSP belongs to the web origin
(Timestamp disclosure) - RFC 3339 instants are part of the contract
(Modern Web Application) - N/A for a JSON API
(Sec-Fetch headers) - not applicable to server-to-server calls
